meta.model: decode key = the 32-char encode template (fixed 0/1 = fixed bit, letter = variable); a word decodes when (word & mask) == value. functionInfo is auxiliary (slot naming + anchor audit only, never merged into the key). Identical-key rows resolve to a single lead (first anchor-clean row in table order, else table first); losers carry lead=false and are not indexed. decode across leads = most-specific win; an equal-specificity distinct-key overlap is a build failure. find() (emips.instruction) is the legacy coarse table lookup (opcode + short fct slice) and intentionally diverges from decode; the fixed Release3 divergent words are listed in audit.golden_bridge.

conventions.positions: msb/lsb are 0-indexed from the MSB (lsb = msb + length - 1); decode extracts (word >> (31 - (msb+length-1))) & ((1<<length)-1)
conventions.decode rule: among lead entries, (word & mask) == value, most-specific (highest fixed-bit count) wins
conventions.tie-break rule: identical (mask,value) -> first anchor-clean row in table order (else table first) leads
conventions.status: core = implement fully; overlay = documented no-op/mapping; unimpl = decode then raise illegal-instruction
